n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Right, the value-clothes shop. Cheap and cheerful! You need a warm coat before winter. Let's look.

translations.fa: خب، فروشگاه لباس ارزون. ارزون و شاد! قبل از زمستون یه کت گرم لازم داری. بیا ببینیم.

branches.suggestion: This one looks warm. Can I try it on?
branches.suggestionFa: این یکی گرم به نظر میاد. می‌تونم پروش کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Do they sell coats here? It's so big!

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Of course! The fitting rooms are at the back. You can take six items. They give you a number tag.

translations.fa: البته! اتاق‌های پرو ته فروشگاهه. می‌تونی شش تیکه ببری. یه برچسب شماره بهت میدن.

branches.suggestion: Six items? Then I'll take a jumper too.
branches.suggestionFa: شش تیکه؟ پس یه بلوز بافتنی هم می‌برم.

cultureNote.en: In UK clothes shops, staff count your items into the fitting room and give you a tag. You return the tag when you come out.
cultureNote.fa: کارکنان تعداد لباس‌ها را می‌شمارند و برچسب می‌دهند.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: So you don't walk out with three jumpers on! Go on, try it. I'll wait here. Well? How is it?

translations.fa: که با سه تا بلوز تنت بیرون نری! برو، امتحانش کن. همین‌جا منتظرم. خب؟ چطوره؟

branches.suggestion: It's too small. The sleeves are short.
It fits! But it's a bit tight here.

recasts.echo: Too small? Let's get a bigger size.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Let's find a bigger size. That's a medium. You need a large. I'll ask the lady. Excuse me — have you got this in large?

translations.fa: بیا سایز بزرگ‌تر پیدا کنیم. اون مدیومه. تو لارج لازم داری. از خانمه می‌پرسم. ببخشید — اینو سایز لارج دارین؟

branches.suggestion: Can I help? I can ask her.
Thanks, Leslie. In black, if possible.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: She says they've only got large in green. Here. Try this. Oh! That's a good colour on you. It really suits you.

translations.fa: میگه لارج فقط سبز دارن. بیا. اینو امتحان کن. اوه! این رنگ بهت میاد. واقعاً بهت میاد.

branches.suggestion: Really? I don't usually wear green.
It does suit me! And it's warm.

cultureNote.en: "It suits you" is about style or colour. "It fits you" is about size.
cultureNote.fa: «suits» یعنی به تو می‌آید؛ «fits» یعنی اندازه است.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Twenty-five pounds! For a winter coat, that's a bargain. Does it have a hood? London rain is sideways.

translations.fa: بیست و پنج پوند! برای یه کت زمستونی، مفته. کلاه داره؟ بارون لندن کج می‌باره.

branches.suggestion: Yes, it has a hood. I'll take it.

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Very real. Wait until November! Right — pay at the till by the door, and keep the receipt in case you change your mind.

translations.fa: خیلی واقعی. صبر کن تا نوامبر! خب — دم در پولش را بده و رسید را نگه دار شاید نظرت عوض شد.

branches.suggestion: How long can I return it for?
Good idea. Are you buying anything?

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Usually twenty-eight days here. And me? Just socks for William. He's eaten… I mean, lost… four pairs this month.

translations.fa: معمولاً اینجا بیست و هشت روز. و من؟ فقط جوراب برای ویلیام. چهار جفت… یعنی، گم کرده… این ماه چهار جفت.
